name: Vaporize
description: The first clip goes up in smoke: from one side the picture turns to vapour that rises, curls into wisps and pales as it thins out, revealing the second clip underneath. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the vapour rises toward (x right, y up)

params.name: rise
params.description: How high the vapour rises above the picture before it is gone, in frame heights

params.name: swirl
params.description: How much the vapour swirls and curls as it rises

params.name: color
params.description: Color the vapour pales to as it thins out
